title: Sampling
description: A Synthesis II assignment. We were given a 30-second recording of cows mooing and tasked with building a full set of instruments from it using Ableton's Simpler instrument. Not every sound came out pristine, but the exercise was more about learning to scrub a sample, isolate its character, and shape it into something new through envelope, filter, and sampling parameters.
